technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot Test framework with JUnit 5 to build acceptance tests for all specified source and processor modules.

Utilize Testcontainers and embedded test servers (e.g., GreenMail for Mail, Apache SSHD / Testcontainers for SFTP, WireMock for HTTP Client) to perform isolated end-to-end integration and acceptance testing.
Standardize test harness conventions and utility classes across source and processor modules to ensure consistent reporting and maintenance.
Configure Maven/Gradle build scripts so that acceptance tests run automatically as part of the CI pipeline.
assumptions: Source code for all 8 modules (Mail, reactor-ip, reactor-syslog, SFTP, aggregator, analytic-pmml, bridge, http-client) is available and fully functional.
A CI build environment (e.g., GitHub Actions or Jenkins) with Docker support is available for running Testcontainers.
Sample PMML models, mock mail messages, and sample syslog payloads are available or can be easily constructed for test data generation.
No core functionality changes to the target modules are required; work is strictly limited to creating and integrating acceptance tests.

activities.activity_description: Establish standard base test classes, shared test utilities, container management helpers, and dependency configurations across the project.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Mail Source Module (U1)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using GreenMail/embedded server to validate email polling, message parsing, and payload emission to downstream channels.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for reactor-ip Source Module (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests for TCP/UDP reactive IP ingestion, verifying stream processing and socket event handling under test scenarios.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for reactor-syslog Source Module (U3)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests for reactive Syslog message ingestion (RFC 3164/5424 formats) and message header/payload assertions.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for SFTP Source Module (U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using an embedded/containerized SFTP server to test file fetching, remote synchronization, and message dispatching.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Aggregator Processor Module (U5)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests to verify message correlation strategies, release rules, completion timeouts, and aggregated output generation.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Analytic-PMML Processor Module (U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using sample PMML predictive models to validate input evaluation, scoring calculations, and output transformations.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Bridge Processor Module (U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests verifying transparent message passthrough between input and output channels, including header propagation.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for HTTP-Client Processor Module (U8)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using WireMock to verify HTTP request dispatching, header mapping, status code handling, and payload conversion.
Integrate test execution into CI build configurations, verify build stability in headless environment, fix any flaky tests, and document execution steps.
